name: perf-portal
//packageManager: PINNED, because corepack otherwise resolves whatever pnpm is newest at build time. infra/Dockerfile runs `corepack enable` with no pin and got pnpm 11 against a lockfile written by pnpm 9, which failed the image build with ERR_PNPM_LOCKFILE_CONFIG_MISMATCH on the `overrides` block. Same class of failure as the openjdk-21 one that file records: a floating dependency in a build nothing runs. `pnpm/action-setup` reads this field, so its `version:` input must NOT also be set.

scripts.preinstall: node -e "const [maj]=process.versions.node.split('.').map(Number); if (maj < 22) { console.error('\nNode ' + process.versions.node + ' is below this repo\'s floor of 22. Run: nvm use\n'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.build: tsc -b && pnpm --filter @perfportal/api build && pnpm --filter @perfportal/worker build && pnpm --filter @perfportal/runner build && pnpm run build:web
scripts.compose:check: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml config --quiet && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile onprem config --quiet
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/test/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/worker/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/worker/test/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/runner/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/runner/test/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/e2e/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/test/tsconfig.json
